text:
rachel: Quick syncwe're doing a minimal base-image rebuild and signing window next Mon 2026-04-11. Need RBAC/JIT plan, audit sinks, vuln gating, and rollback rules.

tom: How long for the signer window?

rachel: 90 minutes. Prefer to avoid key policy changes if we can. Options: temporary IAM binding or SA impersonation.

priya: Impersonation is preferred. We can use `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=svc-image-builder@proj` and call KMS sign API. That keeps key IAM untouched.

tom: If we must do binding, restrict to exact serviceAccount member and auto-revoke script. e.g.:

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signer --member="serviceAccount:svc-image-builder@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.signer"
```

and remove after.

rachel: Audit checklist: 1) IAM policy change logs -> logs sink `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-iam`; 2) KMS CryptoKey access logs -> SIEM rule `kms-usage`; 3) cosign signatures & attestations stored in Artifact Registry metadata and mirrored to containeranalysis.

build-bot: Pre-window reminder scheduled: 2026-04-11T08:20:00Z -> posting to #eng-security.

priya: Vuln gating: capture pre-scrub SBOM + trivy baseline. Post-scrub run `trivy fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH ./rootfs` and `syft packages -o json > sbom.json`. Fail and rollback on any NEW CRITICAL CVEs compared to baseline.

tom: Runtime canary: deploy 2 pods, 3m warmup, hit `/healthz` and small infer path. Thresholds: error rate <5% and p95 latency <250ms. If fail, auto-rollback to last-signed image.

rachel: Add runbook snippet: "If canary fails -> revoke impersonation tokens (if used) -> scale back to :signed-vX -> collect logs -> open incident #release-war-room".

priya: I'll add the diff script `tools/diff_vulns.py` to pipeline to compare pre/post trivy outputs and fail CI on new CRITICALs.

tom: I'll prepare add/remove scripts under `infra/signer-window/` and a PR template that requires 2 approvers (eng + security).

sec-bot: Alert created `kms-sign-activity` -> routes to #eng-oncall and will auto-open incident if signing occurs outside scheduled window.

rachel: Action items: tom = scripts + PR; priya = vuln diff + SBOM attachments; sec-bot = verify alerts/incidents wired; build-bot = reminders. Please ack when PRs live. :thumbsup:

priya: ack, pushing pipeline change.

tom: ack, creating PR now.

sec-bot: Reminder posted 20m before window.
